resources.string: Open the chat on your computer

Receive answer and decision alerts for permitted chats, including work started on the computer. Only project and chat names are shown, never answer text. Monitoring uses a persistent notification and battery power.
After a restart, open the app to reconnect. No automatic start at boot. Delivery may pause in Doze or when the computer is offline.
This host does not support notifications yet. Refresh the connection after upgrading it.
Notifications could not be enabled. Check notification access and system restrictions, then try again.
Local preferences saved; waiting for host synchronization.
OnePlus: allow background activity and check sleep/standby optimization in system settings. These settings do not guarantee delivery after force stop.
